description: Defines data transfer objects (DTOs) related to authentication, including login requests, token responses, and refresh requests.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Contains username and password fields for login requests.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Contains access and refresh tokens in response to authentication.

classes.name: RefreshRequest
classes.description: Contains refresh token for token renewal.

methods.name: TokenResponse
methods.description: Constructor to initialize access and refresh tokens.
